notes: Web searching stopped answering after 20 searches (the session's allowance was used up), so most of this slice was researched by reading known addresses directly: the campaign sites, the counties', cities' and school districts' own pages, and the parties' own pages. The candidates with nothing below who could not be searched for are Roger B. Hess Jr., Neil Garlock, Hailey Flickinger, Lindsey Cooksey, Christopher Klinghagen, Brandon Taylor, Betsy Tino, Mike Wobbe and the two judges; a second pass with searching would be worth it for them.

Not read, because the site refuses scripts or asks them to stay out (nothing was worked around): mncourts.gov (403, so no judge pages), mn.gov (a CAPTCHA; not requested again, so no Governor's appointment notices), co.wabasha.mn.us, stmichaelmn.gov and cityofdetroitlakes.com (robots.txt asks scripts to stay out), beckercountydfl.org, sd40mngop.com and lwvrosevillearea.org (a bot check).

The campaign websites the candidates filed were learned by running the kit's own step (python -m ballot.local_sites files) on a scratch copy of the database; each was then opened and read. No Republican party page was found that publishes its 2026 endorsement of Tom Dippel or Justin Middaugh (the Senate District 44 Republicans list Middaugh under 'Republican Party Candidates' without the word endorsed), so neither has an endorsed_by entry.
